mapper.update: UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET status = 'PARSING', stage = 'PARSING', progress = 30, heartbeat_at = #{heartbeatAt}, deadline_at = #{deadlineAt}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PARSING', 'EXTRACTING', 'ASSEMBLING') AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET status = 'FAILED', fail_code = #{failCode}, reanalyzable = #{reanalyzable}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('QUEUED', 'PARSING', 'EXTRACTING', 'ASSEMBLING') AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET partial = 1, partial_reason = #{partialReason}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('PARSING', 'EXTRACTING', 'ASSEMBLING') AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', progress = 100, fail_code = NULL, reanalyzable = 0, expire_at = #{expireAt}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'ASSEMBLING' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND deadline_at >= #{currentTime}

UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET status = 'FAILED', fail_code = 'SERVER_ERROR', reanalyzable = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE status IN ('PARSING', 'EXTRACTING', 'ASSEMBLING') AND heartbeat_at < #{heartbeatThreshold} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET status = 'FAILED', fail_code = 'EXECUTION_TIMEOUT', reanalyzable = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE status IN ('PARSING', 'EXTRACTING', 'ASSEMBLING') AND deadline_at < #{currentTime} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE ct_health_report_task SET status = 'FAILED', fail_code = 'SERVER_ERROR', reanalyzable = 1, version = version + 1, update_by = #{updateBy} WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND create_time < #{queuedThreshold} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ct_health_report_task WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR status = 'SUCCEEDED' OR (status = 'FAILED' AND (reanalyzable = 0 OR expire_at <= #{currentTime})) ORDER BY expire_at, task_id LIMIT #{batchSize}
